name: mission-reminder
description: Mission-anchored time blocking. A tree grows while you keep your blocks; it wilts when you drift.

scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @mission/core && npm run build -w @mission/data
scripts.desktop: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @mission/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/data && npm run typecheck -w @mission/desktop -w @mission/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm test -w @mission/core && npm test -w @mission/data && node scripts/make-icons.test.mjs
